entries.abc7b0233a12df54: Its subsidiary Shokuryu Co., Ltd. sells seafood without going through wholesale markets. Through a sales network of 30-odd locations nationwide, it sells to domestic markets, mass retailers, hotels and the food service industry various seafood products, including frozen shrimp imported from dozens of countries such as Indonesia, India and Australia, as well as its own processed products. Fresh fish such as horse mackerel, Spanish mackerel and mackerel are shipped and sold to domestic markets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥139,596 million.
entries.bb58cecf7b92b427: Its management philosophy is “Centered on seafood, we contribute to the development of food culture by providing customers with valuable products and services,” and its basic policy for group management is “to create a new seafood distribution services industry, a total system of seafood distribution from producers to consumers, and provide customers with safety, security and satisfaction.” It is the final year of the ‘OUG Group Medium-Term Management Plan 2024,’ which covers fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026, and it is working on business themes of strengthening the fresh fish business, strengthening product competitiveness, deepening and expanding the Kanto market, expanding overseas business, and sustainable business activities.

entries.d59543a9935dc88b: A business model in which the group covers each stage of seafood distribution, centered on consignment sales at wholesale markets and off-market wholesale, and extending to aquaculture, food processing and logistics.
entries.de22f47cb8604138: The Seafood Consignment Sales Business has a collection and sales function centered on central wholesale markets. The Off-Market Seafood Wholesale Business has a broad distribution network that uses sales bases covering all regions of Japan, and imports seafood from dozens of countries around the world. The group also has aquaculture, food processing and logistics businesses and covers each stage of seafood distribution.
entries.e127a8bf1b740843: The company operates businesses at each stage of seafood distribution, from consignment sales at wholesale markets and off-market seafood wholesale to yellowtail and tuna aquaculture, food processing of cooked rice and cut vegetables, and logistics for seafood and other products.
entries.f39fdfcb77df3f1c: This business processes foods, mainly seafood. Its subsidiaries Daiwa Summit Co., Ltd. process cooked rice products such as rice balls for mass retailers, Tounichi Suisan Co., Ltd. processes cut vegetables, mainly sashimi no Ken, and Tsuna Craft Works Co., Ltd. processes frozen tuna. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,486 million.
